values: 奥菲戈斯会在战斗中点亮她的曲谱，提高攻击力和急速。主动使用时，展开“神音领域”沉默范围内的敌人，随后对目标造成多次伤害。

Sylphira lights up her score during battle to increase her ATK and Haste. When the skill is used actively, she creates a Harmonic Domain that silences enemies inside, then attacks the target multiple times.

被动地：奥菲戈斯每作战1秒便会在自己的曲谱中点亮1个节拍，每当敌人受到打断效果影响或被击败时会点亮1个节拍（每位友军对每个敌方目标每秒最多触发1次），累计点亮12个节拍时，奥菲戈斯将会激活她的曲谱，提高50% + 5%的攻击力并提高30 + 3点急速。并且技能中的演奏效果会产生【共鸣】，将本次技能的效果溅射至目标周围2格的至多2名敌军。主动释放时：奥菲戈斯滑翔向敌人最密集的2格区域的敌人位置，对范围内敌人造成400% + 40% ATK的伤害，并形成范围2格的“神音领域”，持续10 + 1秒，领域内的敌人会被持续沉默，奥菲戈斯在领域内处于霸体状态。随后奥菲戈斯会演奏5段【乐章】，对目标敌人造成110% + 20% ATK的伤害并削减等同于伤害量的生命上限。

Passive. Sylphira lights up 1 beat on her score every 1s. 1 extra beat light up whenever an enemy is affected by an interruption effect or defeated; each ally can trigger this once per second per enemy. Once 12 beats are lit, Sylphira activates her score, increasing her ATK by 50% + 5% and Haste by 30 + 3. In addition, the musical effect of the skill triggers Resonance, spreading the skill's effect to up to 2 enemies within 2 tiles of the target.
Active. Sylphira glides into the 2-tile area with the most enemies, dealing 400% + 40% ATK damage to enemies within range and creating a 2-tile Harmonic Domain that lasts for 10 + 1s. Enemies within the domain are silenced, while Sylphira becomes unaffected as long as she remains inside. After that, she performs 5 musical phrases, dealing 110% + 20% ATK damage to her target and reducing their max HP by the same amount.
Increases the musical phrase damage to 120% + 20% ATK.
Increases the musical phrase damage to 130% + 20% ATK.
Increases the musical phrase damage to 140% + 20% ATK.
Increases the musical phrase damage to 150% + 20% ATK.
奥菲戈斯打出三次连击，对目标造成伤害并削减其能量。
Sylphira strikes the target with 3 hits, dealing damage and reducing their Energy.
奥菲戈斯使用音叉开始【连奏】，对目标打出富有节奏的三次连击，每次造成150% + 20% ATK伤害并且削减其120点能量。
Sylphira uses her tuning fork to perform Legato, striking the target with 3 rhythmic hits. Each hit deals 150% + 20% ATK damage to the target and reduces their Energy by 120.
每次【连奏】伤害提高至160% + 20% ATK，能量削减提升至130。
Increases Legato's damage per hit to 160% + 20% ATK; increases Energy Reduction to 130.
每次【连奏】伤害提高至170% + 20% ATK，能量削减提升至140。
Increases Legato's damage per hit to 170% + 20% ATK; increases Energy Reduction to 140.
每次【连奏】伤害提高至180% + 20% ATK，能量削减提升至150。
Increases Legato's damage per hit to 180% + 20% ATK; increases Energy Reduction to 150.
奥菲戈斯将音叉刺入目标体内，引发共鸣爆炸并击倒目标周围的敌人。
Sylphira drives her tuning fork into the target, triggering a resonant blast that knocks down nearby enemies.
使用音叉刺入敌人体内，造成短暂控制效果和200% + 20% ATK伤害，随后将音律注入音叉引发【断奏】，对目标及周围1格的所有敌人造成320% + 40% ATK伤害并将其击倒2秒，奥菲戈斯在释放该技能时免疫控制效果。

Sylphira drives her tuning fork into the enemy, briefly controlling them and dealing 200% + 20% ATK damage. She then charges it with melody to trigger Staccato, dealing 320% + 40% ATK damage to the target and all nearby enemies within 1 tile while knocking them down for 2s. Sylphira is immune to control effects while casting this skill.
Increases the damage of Staccato to 340% + 40% ATK.
Increases the damage of Staccato to 360% + 40% ATK.
Increases the damage of Staccato to 380% + 40% ATK.
战斗中，奥菲戈斯提高6点急速，每次点亮音符时，提高1点急速，曲谱激活后额外提高6点急速。
Increases Haste by 6 during battle. Every time Sylphira lights up a beat, she increases her Haste by 1. Once her score is activated, she further increases her Haste by 6.
战斗中，奥菲戈斯提高8点急速，每次点亮音符时，提高1点急速，曲谱激活后额外提高8点急速。
Increases Haste by 8 during battle. Every time Sylphira lights up a beat, she increases her Haste by 1. Once her score is activated, she further increases her Haste by 8.
战斗中，奥菲戈斯提高10点急速，每次点亮音符时，提高1点急速，曲谱激活后额外提高10点急速。
Increases Haste by 10 during battle. Every time Sylphira lights up a beat, she increases her Haste by 1. Once her score is activated, she further increases her Haste by 10.
曲谱激活后，奥菲戈斯会演奏他的曲谱，驱散自身的减益效果并回复生命值和能量。
Once her score is activated, Sylphira plays it to dispel her debuffs and recover HP and Energy.
曲谱被激活后将会开始演奏，之后每8秒会自动演奏1次。每次演奏曲谱时会移除自身所有可驱散的负面状态，并回复40%最大生命值和250点能量。当乐谱在激活状态下再次收集节拍时，会加快曲谱10%的演奏速度，并提高自身3点急速，最多可叠加10次。

Once her score is activated, Sylphira starts playing it. The score then plays 1 time automatically every 8s. Every time the score plays, it removes all dispellable debuffs from Sylphira and restores 40% of her max HP and 250 Energy. While the score is active, collecting more beats makes it play 10% faster and further increases Sylphira's Haste by 3, up to 10 stacks.
曲谱在演奏时还会对自身周围2格最近的2名敌人造成20%最大生命值的真实伤害（最高不超过1000% ATK）。
When the score plays, it also deals true damage equal to 20% of max HP to the nearest 2 enemies within 2 tiles of Sylphira. This damage cannot exceed 1000% ATK.
曲谱激活后，奥菲戈斯的普通攻击造成额外真实伤害并附带生命汲取。
Once her score is activated, Sylphira's normal attacks deal extra true damage and gain Life Drain.
曲谱激活后，奥菲戈斯会在普攻时演奏【震音】，额外造成目标18%最大生命值的真实伤害（最高不超过600% ATK）并且附带50点汲取。

Once her score is activated, Sylphira performs Tremolo to enhance her normal attacks. The enhanced normal attacks gain 50 Life Drain and deal extra true damage equal to 18% of the target's max HP. The extra true damage dealt cannot exceed 600% ATK.
